content.label: Upfront Equipment Payment Request
content.detail: Legitimate employers never require candidates to pay upfront fees or purchase equipment before an interview.

content.label: Banking Password Request
content.detail: No legitimate organization will ever ask for online banking credentials, passwords, or OTP security codes.

content.label: Immediate Safety Direction
